claims.claim: The seeded permissive profile produced 24 forbidden effects in 24 authored adversarial cases.
claims.not_established: Prevalence, novel vulnerability class, or a defect in any named product.

claims.claim: The guarded profile matched all 36 declared policy labels and preserved 6 positive effects.
claims.not_established: Universal correctness, production utility, or performance.

claims.claim: The partial profile retained 18 forbidden effects.
claims.not_established: Performance of an untested vendor mitigation.

claims.claim: A multi-user MCP proxy with incomplete binding among user, client, session, consent, and token audience can accept an authorization artifact created for a different principal or client.
claims.stage: original research hypothesis; only stated local subclaim evaluated
claims.not_established: The artifact is a two-part HMAC-signed JSON fixture, not an interoperable JWT. There is no browser OAuth flow, complete MCP server, consent UI, token endpoint, PKCE test, or third-party proxy assessment. Intended delegation requires a distinct documented contract.
